basic_details.job_title: ECHS Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 10 Clerk, Nursing Assistant and More Posts
basic_details.total_vacancies: Medical Officer, Dental Officer, Nursing Assistant (General), Pharmacist, Lab Technician, Dental Assistant, Clerk, Chowkidar, Female Attendant, Safaiwala
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

important_dates.interview_date: Third week of December 2026, by Phone/SMS/E-Mail

qualification.details: Age limit: The notice gives a maximum age of 65 years. | Preferred for Medical Officer: Additional qualification in Medicine/Surgery. | Only candidates meeting the Qualitative Requirements may apply. See the official notification (PDF) for the eligibility of each post.

selection_process: Selection is by interview. The notice says candidates will be informed on Phone/SMS/E-Mail of the exact interview date in the third week of December 2026. Candidates are requested to report physically
while out-station candidates have the option of giving the interview on video call.
Bring the following to the interview:
diploma and course documents Work experience documents Passport size colour photographs
No Traveling Allowances/Dearness Allowances are admissible.
how_to_apply: Get the application format from the ECHS website, which also carries the terms and conditions and additional details.
Fill in the application in the requisite format.
Attach self-attested photocopies of testimonials supporting your educational qualifications and work experience.
Submit the application in duplicate to OIC, ECHS Cell, Station Headquarters, Leh. Any application received after 20 November 2026 will not be accepted.

Every applicant must declare whether they are presently in receipt of any resettlement facility or benefit under the Department of Ex-Servicemen Welfare (DoESW)/DGR. The applicant must also undertake not to receive any such benefit simultaneously if selected and appointed as a contractual employee under ECHS.

content_sections.heading: About ECHS
content_sections.text: The Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS) comes under the Government of India, Ministry of Defence, as its letterhead shows. Station HQ (ECHS Cell), Leh issued this employment notice.

rows.event: Last date for receipt of application

rows.date: Third week of December 2026, by Phone/SMS/E-Mail

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is by interview. The notice says candidates will be informed on Phone/SMS/E-Mail of the exact interview date in the third week of December 2026. Candidates are requested to report physically, while out-station candidates have the option of giving the interview on video call. Bring the following to the interview: All original certificates, mark sheets, degree, diploma and course documents Work experience documents Passport size colour photographs No Traveling Allowances/Dearness Allowances are admissible.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Ex-Servicemen are engaged on a contractual basis for one year, and civilian staff for 11 months. The contract is renewable for an additional one year/11 months, or till the candidate attains the maximum age of 65 years. Renewal is subject to the performance of candidates and other conditions. Misrepresentation of facts renders the appointment liable to immediate termination, without prejudice to any other action.

faq.question: Q1. Can civilians apply for these ECHS Leh posts?
faq.answer: Yes. Civilians have a 40% share for the Medical Officer and Dental Officer posts and a 30% share for the other eight posts.

faq.question: Q2. Which posts pay the most and the least?
faq.answer: Medical Officer and Dental Officer carry the highest fixed remuneration at ₹ 95,000/-. Chowkidar, Female Attendant and Safaiwala carry the lowest at ₹ 21,800/-.

faq.question: Q3. What is needed for the Clerk post?
faq.answer: A candidate must be a Graduate or hold the Class-I Clerical Trade (Armed Forces), with minimum 05 years of experience. The post has 01 vacancy.

faq.question: Q4. Which posts are open to candidates who are only literate?
faq.answer: Female Attendant and Safaiwala require a literate candidate with 05 years of experience. For Female Attendant, that experience must be in Civil/Army Health institutions.

faq.question: Q5. How many sets of the application must be submitted?
faq.answer: The application must be submitted in duplicate to OIC, ECHS Cell, Station Headquarters, Leh.

faq.question: Q6. Is the affidavit required at the interview stage?
faq.answer: No. The Affidavit/Undertaking must be furnished at the time of submitting the application.

faq.question: Q7. Can an out-station candidate attend the interview online?
faq.answer: Yes. Out-station candidates have the option of giving the interview on video call.

faq.question: Q8. Will travel costs be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no Traveling Allowances/Dearness Allowances are admissible.
